Monthly garage parking fees increase every six months. Management has taken over nearly all the guest parking around the building, and now staff are occupying garage spaces to charge their personal cars using the outlets—while residents get reprimanded for using those same outlets. For clarity, this review concerns the Beacon’s rental management office. The Rialto–Capital owner units operate separately and are not the subject of this review.
